question: The violation of Fundamental Rights could be redressed by the Supreme Court under which of the following Articles?
solution:
The correct answer is** 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​We have legal recourse if any of** our rights are violated. **We can go straight to the **Supreme Court or the High Court of a state** if it involves a Fundamental Right. **The Right to Constitutional Remedies** was referred to by** Dr. Ambedkar** as the** "heart and soul" **of our **Constitution for this reason.**
 
• When a party's** fundamental rights are violated, **both the **Supreme Court and the high court have the authority to issue writs**. These writs include** mandamus, quo warranto, prohibition, habeas corpus, and certiorari.**
 
• **Article 32 is the heart and spirit of the Constitution,** according to **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, and rights granted by it will always be exercised in the** Supreme Court **unless an alteration has been made in it. 
 
• **Everybody, not just citizens, **have a right to access the **supreme court under Article 32 **of the constitution. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Constitution's Article 301 addresses the freedom of trade, commerce, and sexual activity. **It states that trade, **commerce, and intercourse **shall be unfettered throughout the** territory of India,** subject to the other requirements of this Part. 
 
• **All of India's High Courts are authorised** to issue writs under **Article 226. **Writs of India are taken directly from "Prerogative writs" in English law.
 
• The Indian Constitution's** Article 265** addresses the issue of taxes that may only be levied by** legal permission.** It signifies that only legal authority has the** right to levy and collect taxes. **

 

​​

af:T
